info.description: The Hotel Rooms Inventory API provides access to the current inventory of hotel rooms, enabling consumers to view available rooms and their statuses. This API serves hotels, property managers, and booking platforms, facilitating efficient room management and reservation processes. Users can retrieve detailed information about each room, including type, availability, and pricing. This functionality is essential for enhancing customer experience by ensuring accurate and up-to-date room listings.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to access the current inventory of rooms available in the system, providing details on their status, availability, and other relevant information.
